# Timber Trace Crafts

> Timber Trace Crafts is a veteran-owned small business based in Avon Park, Florida, specializing in precision laser-cut woodcrafts and custom decor. Founded and operated by Michael J. Miller, a disabled veteran who served during Desert Storm. Products include handcrafted wooden jewelry (earrings, pendants), personalized jewelry boxes, and engraved tumblers.

## About

- Founded by Michael J. Miller, disabled veteran (Desert Storm era)
- One-person studio: all pieces designed, laser-cut, and hand-finished in-house
- Based in Avon Park, Florida, USA
- Specializes in laser-cut wooden jewelry, jewelry boxes, and custom tumblers
- Materials: Maple, Baltic Birch, Basswood, cherry, walnut, oak; wood-and-resin combinations
- All pieces precision laser-cut and hand-finished
- Custom and personalized orders accepted

## Products

- [Shop](https://timbertracecrafts.com/shop): Full product catalog
- Wooden earrings: dangle, drop, and stud styles in wood and resin
- Personalized jewelry boxes: engraved wooden keepsake boxes
- America 250 Tumbler: stainless steel engraved tumbler commemorating the 2026 U.S. Semiquincentennial
- Custom laser-cut gifts: ornaments, signs, and home decor
